title: UFO — Balanced colour locations
direction: Restore clear local scenery colours and warm/cool variety while keeping broad quiet ground, unchanged target colours, a shared cast, the same camera, models and HUD.

frames.name: sage-farmland-balanced
frames.title: Farmland — sage, wheat and terracotta
frames.palette: Dusty sage fields, terracotta roofs, wheat hay and plum-green foliage
frames.edit: LOCATION-SPECIFIC PALETTE: make the grass a pleasant LIGHT DUSTY SAGE GREEN with a little yellow-green warmth, not grey. Restore the barn roof to muted TERRACOTTA / brick-coral, walls warm CREAM/stone; restore fence rails to subdued natural warm WOOD BROWN. Hay cylinders should be warm pale WHEAT/OCHRE, significantly softer than the bright amber hats. Trees and shrubs use two related muted OLIVE / deep SAGE greens, with a few subtly plum-tinted shadow planes for depth; not all foliage identical grey-green. Dirt paths light warm BEIGE, silo quiet blue-grey metal. Keep crop rows and crop-circle trace within a subtle sage field palette, not high-contrast. Retain a broad quiet green centre and add no grass/clutter. Sunlight gently warm, shadows softly cool. Overall a friendly naturally coloured farm with controlled saturation and distinct prop colours; living targets remain visually foremost. The monochrome input should be clearly improved in warmth and colour variety.

frames.name: slate-suburbia-balanced
frames.title: Suburbia — blue streets and warm homes
frames.palette: Dusty blue-grey road, muted coral/teal roofs, cream walls, sage hedges and small warm windows
frames.edit: LOCATION-SPECIFIC PALETTE: keep broad empty street DUSTY BLUE-GREY / desaturated slate, but give the houses proper subdued local colours: some roofs muted CORAL/brick, others muted PETROL TEAL, plaster warm OFF-WHITE / CREAM, pavements warm pale STONE. Small windows can glow softly pale AMBER, not bright neon, and only a few visible windows at edges. Hedges/trees become subdued natural SAGE GREEN with blue-violet shadows rather than all grey-blue. Mailboxes quiet dusty red or petrol teal, bins neutral charcoal. Keep the street visually quiet and unobstructed; avoid decorative road markings. Gentle cool evening fill and small touches of warm domestic light create sleepy cosy character; scene remains bright enough for phone gameplay. It must clearly look more colourful than input, yet the bright cast, coral warnings and mint effects still lead attention. No fully grey foliage or every roof the same blue.

frames.name: mauve-desert-balanced
frames.title: Desert — ochre, mauve and dusty green
frames.palette: Muted warm ochre ground, mauve rock shadows, dusty sage cacti and rust/cream roadside canopy
frames.edit: LOCATION-SPECIFIC PALETTE: restore desert sand to warm MUTED OCHRE / peach-tan, medium lightness so cream animals still stand out, no bright saturated orange. Rock outcrops have natural DUSTY SANDSTONE / blush upper faces with gentle MAUVE / muted violet shadow planes, keeping purple as a distinctive supporting colour instead of a whole-scene filter. Cacti become dusty SAGE / blue-green, clearly different from rocks and sand, muted rather than vivid. Road is softly desaturated PLUM-GREY with lighter dusty stone markings, roadside posts grey warm wood. Service canopy at bottom-left has a muted RUST RED roof and warm off-white supports, pumps subdued blue-grey and dusty red, no bright signage. Keep central dirt travel space mostly a quiet tan field. Warm neutral desert daylight and cool lavender shadows, no grain or extra ground detail. Make the contrast of warm sand, cooler mauve rocks and sage cacti visually evident without competing with the unchanged saturated target cast and blue UFO.
